# Theory: Bitbucket is Git Hosting Inside an Issue Database

Atlassian’s theory is that code hosting is a satellite of Jira. Cloud vs Data Center is who operates the satellite.

## Invariants

1. Jira keys in branch names and commits are the integration surface.
2. Data Center is the self-host shape; Cloud is the SaaS shape.
3. Lock-in is the Atlassian user directory and issue graph.

```text
Jira  <── links ──>  Bitbucket repos
         same org, same identity
```

## What can break

- Evaluating Bitbucket without counting Jira.

## How to read this chapter

Cloud vs DC, architecture, Jira, enterprise features, comparison, lab, when it fits.
